items.title: Banks Facing Bond Price-Fixing Trial Agree to Pay Over $400 Million
items.summary: Wall Street firms including some of the industry’s biggest banks are nearing an agreement to pay more than $400 million to end a high-stakes lawsuit claiming they schemed to fix prices in the muni bond market.
